mapper.sql: SELECT e.id AS id, e.student_id AS studentId, e.course_id AS courseId, e.enroll_date AS enrollDate, e.lessons AS lessons, e.status AS status, e.created_at AS createdAt, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS studentName, s.level AS studentLevel, s.lesson_balance AS lessonBalance, c.course_no AS courseNo, c.title AS courseTitle, c.teacher_name AS teacherName, c.category AS courseCategory, c.capacity AS capacity, c.enrolled_count AS enrolledCount FROM enrollment e LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = e.student_id LEFT JOIN lesson_course c ON c.id = e.course_id
ORDER BY e.enroll_date DESC, e.id DESC
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id AS studentId, course_id AS courseId, enroll_date AS enrollDate, lessons, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM enrollment WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT id, student_id AS studentId, course_id AS courseId, enroll_date AS enrollDate, lessons, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM enrollment
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollment (student_id, course_id, enroll_date, lessons, status, created_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{enrollDate}, #{lessons}, #{status}, #{createdAt})

mapper.update: UPDATE enrollment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
